title: •Luke’s Blaster Pistol
caption: •Luke’s Blaster Pistol (V)
game_text: Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Twice per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.
lore: Merr-Sonn Model 57. Part of an arms lot purchased for the Alliance from a black market dealer on Ord Mantell. Carried by Luke as backup for his father’s lightsaber.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Luke’s). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. The wiki's default 'Luke's Blaster Pistol' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Luke's Blaster Pistol (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px CC-L-lukesblasterpistol.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs6/16-CC-L-lukesblasterpistol.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from both scans: 'Carried by Luke as backup for his father’s lightsaber.' (wiki has 'as a backup'; curly apostrophe in father’s). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: V8-L-lukesblasterpistol.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 8 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
